parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance for which you want to set a remark.

> You can call [DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

> You can call [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remark for the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.
